paragraphs.text: Study this: a speech so full of rest it cannot be spoken out loud. That unsayable, rest-filled speech is studied as the very heart of the Lord.

Now the rule underneath everything: gods are god-made, every one of them. Being and non-being alike are goddess-made. Knowing and unknowing, your own school and even its enemies — all of it is made. And where does it all land? In oneness: six paths abiding as one, at the end of every system, a goal that cannot be said.

The ground it lands on: a merged heart — the god of gods — undivided ground. Reflect on it and you gain real stages, without getting stuck on ends. Throbbed three, road sixfold: three throbs, six roads.

paragraphs.text: Rest-filled, unsayable, studied as heart. That is the textbook.
All god-made. Being-nonbeing goddess-made. Knowing-unknowing, school-foe: all made. Six-one abiding past every system-end: unsayable goal.
Merged heart, gods-god, undivided ground. Reflect and gain stages, unattached to ends. Throbbed three, road sixfold.
